summary: Two rafters fell out of their raft on the Yampa River within Steamboat Springs; the unoccupied raft was spotted downstream by other parties. Steamboat Springs Fire Rescue coordinated searches along the river with several Routt County SAR members assisting after RCSAR was paged; both rafters self-rescued.
responding_agency: Routt County SAR (paged, assisting); Steamboat Springs Fire Rescue (swift-water lead)
notes: From RCSAR Far Routt Newsletter Summer 2024 edition (opened this run): "May 28, 2024 - Missing Rafters on the Yampa River" - RCSAR paged to assist SSFR, the swift-water lead agency, with a possible rescue within Steamboat Springs city limits; SSFR coordinated searches along the river with several RCSAR members assisting; the two rafters self-rescued. Cross-line lead flagged for this line at run 289; date-pinned and verified this run.
